data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter timeline scrubber widget for navigating time‑based data.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable, zoomable timeline with draggable handles to change the visible date range. Displays tasks on the timeline and notifies when the window changes.
use_when: You need a simple timeline scrubber for Gantt charts, video/audio editors, or similar time‑based UI.
You want a lightweight, platform‑agnostic widget with customizable appearance and zoom support.
avoid_when: You require full‑featured charting or analytics beyond a basic scrubber.
You need built‑in data fetching, state management, or heavy performance optimizations for massive datasets.
weaknesses: No built‑in data source or advanced chart features
May need additional logic for large task sets
